CommunityApplications.Profile:
Templates for **Home Ops** — a self-hosted household management system: chores, a shared calendar, recipes and meal planning, groceries, contacts, notes and health records, running on hardware you own.
Home Ops ships as a **single container**: FastAPI, nginx and PostgreSQL 16 together under s6-overlay, with one appdata path and one port. There is nothing to wire together and nothing to sign up for — no cloud account, no API key, no telemetry.
It is built for a household rather than a company, so **visibility is per record** (private, shared with named people, or the whole household) and there is no administrator override on any of it.
Support and issues: https://github.com/g0browns/Home-ops/issues
